trusted_callback_origin_audit.constructor_signature: StageBOwner(relations, authority_snapshots, trusted_semantic_hash, trusted_canonicalize, trusted_require_positive_authority, relation_class, authority_snapshot_class)
trusted_callback_origin_audit.validation_performed: PyCallable_Check on the three callables and PyType_Check on the two classes only
trusted_callback_origin_audit.pinning: the five references are INCREF'd into C at construction and are not re-read from Python afterwards -- correct anti-swap hygiene, but it pins whatever the caller chose
trusted_callback_origin_audit.finding: Pinning caller-supplied callables proves only that they cannot be SWAPPED afterwards; it does not establish that they are trusted code. Any Python caller can construct a StageBOwner with its own semantic_hash, canonicalize, require_positive_authority, relation class and snapshot class.
trusted_callback_origin_audit.demonstrated: reproduction/hq246_parity_probe.py attacker_custody_owner: an owner built entirely from attacker classes and callables seals (sealed=True, counts=(1,1)), reports a 64-hex custody_hash, and resolve_exact returns the attacker's own relation object
trusted_callback_origin_audit.qualification: This is acceptable ONLY as a TCB-assumed test seam inside a quarantined harness that supplies the production functions. It is NOT admissible for production adoption without a production-owned, sealed construction gate that fixes the callable and class identities (e.g. a native factory owning exactly the accepted functions, or a signed/sealed capsule created outside caller reach).

custody_authenticity_probes.different_owner_same_key_empty_victim: the candidate performs exact ref-key lookup against its own sealed C copies, so an independent empty owner refuses the source ref (consistent with Stage A)
custody_authenticity_probes.post_seal_substitute_object_and_ref_swap: detected by the ref.key/content_hash/projection re-hash -- the Stage B court covers these and they were not falsified here
custody_authenticity_probes.malicious_changed_projection_with_fixed_: the FULL semantic_projection re-hash (resolve_exact step c) does catch a changed projection because the sealed reference is the trusted hash of the projection; this is a genuine improvement over Stage A
custody_authenticity_probes.registry_replacement_immunity: no live registry object is retained; custody is C-owned copies -- consistent with the receipts
custody_authenticity_probes.counterfeit_exact_ref_with_equal_payload: accepted iff kind|object_id|content_hash match a sealed ref key; the payload (the relation object) is returned by owned reference and re-verified
custody_authenticity_probes.enumerable_dynamic_python_instances: relevant only to the caller-supplied classes; any exact instance of the caller-named class is admissible, which follows from the provenance finding above

author_class_callable_forgery.detail: a forger who can call the type constructor supplies an always-positive require_positive_authority and self-chosen hashes/classes; the native owner treats them as the TCB
author_class_callable_forgery.observed_after_the_fact: the forged configuration did reach validate_positive; it then crashed on B2/B3 before returning AUTHORIZED, so a clean 'forged AUTHORIZED decision' could NOT be produced in this frozen candidate
author_class_callable_forgery.interpretation: the trust defect is real but currently masked by the memory-safety crash on the positive path
